q: 1. The depth of a shallow manhole should not be more than
explain: A shallow manhole is defined as one with a maximum depth of 2.1 m; beyond this, it is classified as a medium or deep manhole requiring different design.

q: 2. The head of the division of public works department is
explain: In the typical PWD hierarchy, an Executive Engineer heads a Division, while a Superintending Engineer heads a Circle and a Chief Engineer heads the whole department.
An anti-siphonage pipe is connected to the top of the P-trap of a WC to admit air and prevent the trap seal from being siphoned out during flow.

q: 4. 1 Metric horse power is equal to
explain: One metric horsepower equals 736 watts (0.736 kW), consistent with the earlier definition.

q: 5. The correct relationship between rise, R and tread, T is
explain: The standard staircase design rule relating rise (R) and tread (T), used to give a comfortable stride, is 2R + T = 600 (approximately, in mm/cm units as conventionally applied).

q: 6. The head of the circle of public works department is
explain: In the PWD hierarchy, a Superintending Engineer heads a Circle (which comprises several Divisions, each headed by an Executive Engineer).
